prompt: Our supplier-concentration data for Nigeria wheat looks stale. Where would I get accurate current import data by supplier country, and how do I make sure it's actually right?

assertions.text: Recommends UN Comtrade (HS 1001, by partner) as primary for who-supplies-whom
Explains top-5 share / HHI concentration method
Names an independent cross-check (FAOSTAT or national customs), not just Comtrade-derived (ITC/WITS)
States the >10% reconciliation/flag rule and the no-fabrication rule
Flags re-exporter inflation or marketing-year/period alignment as a gotcha
